## 1.0 Introduction

The Optimization problem reveals one of the most important epistemological-systemeic-ontological problems in all of Cyberneering. In Essence, the "best" ideas, parts, implementations or strategies do not necessarily always survive to sustain a System. Sometiems, the most optimal idea, solution or strategy, destroys necesarry local resources of a system (Local resources include: Continuity, Energy, Time, etc.). In essence, the larger the gap between Entropic states (i.e., Epistemic-entropy: Known-and-unknown, or Entropic-ontology: Observable-and-unobservable) the less viable the solution becomes.
